scope: Arithmetic, bindings, solver and repository checks of the land-cities product; the groundwater solve is a screen in uniform rock over a flat base, with no structural or radiation-transport validation

focused.note: Run with the ignored inputs present (atlas and drainage grids, the design climatology, LOLA 16 px/deg, GL0420A, the IAU gazetteer archive) and main's places readable through Git; without them the regeneration test skips

layer_check.note: The stock check reads tracked files only, so it skips this untracked study; its lane rules applied to the six study files directly found 0 violations (research imports shared, geography, engineering and research)

solver_checks.steady_strip: the two-dimensional steady solve on a one-row strip matches (h + b)^2 = b^2 + (R/K) x (2L - x) within 1e-6 m (3e-11 m measured)
solver_checks.capped_strip: the ground-capped strip pins from its analytic free boundary within one cell and matches the free mound within 2 m
solver_checks.rise_against_nonlinear_strip: the rise in a strip keeps within 0.6% of a fully implicit nonlinear 1-D Boussinesq run at half its rise, 3.4% at 90% and 4.3% at 95%, and settles on the steady solve
solver_checks.tight_rock_first_rate: with the high case's conductivity the rise follows the recharge over the specific yield within 2%; at the Tranquillitatis pit, rille K and the Schlueter pit the 2-D high-case rise reached the floor within 1% of the first rate (scratch check)
solver_checks.window: the central capped water table at all 13 land positions is the same to 0.1 m for windows reaching 200, 300, 400 and 600 km (scratch check)
solver_checks.clipping_superseded: a first version capped the water table by clipping after each step; at rille G it settled 28-65 m above the steady solve as the steps grew, so the cap is now settled inside each step as in the steady solve

round_1.reviewer: a read-only agent that recomputed the headline numbers without importing the study's modules (scripts in /media/projectspace/terluna-research/provisioning-runs/land_cities/review/)
round_1.recomputations: 14 of 14 PASS: ground above the sea at seven sites and all 52 classes; the vault; water pressure; seepage and pumping; the 1-D Tranquillitatis water table; the roof that holds air; the conduction lag; capacity and the totals; highland area; rain and lightning; towers; water lift; the sky boat's energies; the scattered communities
disagreements_and_errors: README capacity rows for the rille segments and the Gruithuisen chain disagreed with the product
the undersea population was null through a wrong key
heat in Finding 14 and the tower table used 1.5 and 4.5 kW where the product uses 1.51 and 4.52
the residents' 5-28 GW was not in the product
Finding 2's first-rise times were lower bounds and left out rille H
the mound ratio of 2.46 holds only for a mound large against its base
the summit's rise was called the wettest and stormiest ground; the wettest and stormiest cell lies 327 km from the summit
the Kheyroddin comparison said about half where the model gives 18-41%
rounding: dry-land tubes, the dry-land share and Finding 16's mixed median and percentile
water_table() took values already rounded to three figures
rille H, 22.5 m below the common level on LOLA's 16 px/deg ground, was classed coastal
Atlas.cell() rounded half to even where locate() floors, so rille G took the wrong atlas cell
the coastal test compared distances exactly
the 1-D mound with a heuristic divide was not robust at single places (Tranquillitatis 97 m below the ground against 1,000-1,160 m of uncapped 2-D mound)
the cases did not bracket timing (the high case paired the slowest specific yield with the highest mound)
Gong et al.'s thickness is measured from the mare surface, used as the saturated depth below the shore
the sky boat's range test ignored the climb
a region took its picked candidate's class, so the Marius Hills counted as dry
the canyon sky view factor is a lower bound
the heliostat factor assumes a two-mirror train
zero-width top levels were counted and the GRAIL candidates took full-width levels
box_shares would divide by zero across 0 E
an unused variable; the ways-of-living home's far-side share is the towns' alone

fixes: the README capacity table now reads the product's sums by kind (tubes.capacity.by_type and by_candidate): rilles 1.7-3.0 and 24-42 million, the Gruithuisen chain 0.53-0.93 and 4.9-8.6 million
highlands.scattered reads residents_all_candidates: 48,600
the residents' energy, 5.18-28.0 GW, is in tubes.sealing.residents_energy

the 1-D water table is replaced by a 2-D Dupuit solve on the atlas with the ground cap (groundwater.py), in three cases, and a 2-D Boussinesq rise from the sea's level with times over the specific yield's range; the high case's times are the first rate, which its tight rock follows within 2%
the mound ratio is stated as its limits, 6.0 for a mound small against its base and 2.5 for one that dwarfs it, with 4.2-6.0 at the land places from the solve

Finding 11 names the far side's equatorial massif; the product carries the wettest and stormiest dry cell (19.8 mm a day, 0.072 flashes, 7.5 km up at 2.6 S, 208.6 E, 327 km from the summit) and the summit rings (13.3 mm and 0.048 within 100 km)
the Earth frame against designed towers is computed at 48 and 96 storeys: 17.8 and 38.7 kg/m2, 18-41% of 44-72 and 98-215
rounding and the median and percentile in Finding 16 corrected; the dry-land numbers follow the new region classes
raw ground and water depths feed the water table and the heads
a candidate below the common level on its own ground is under water by the atlas's rule: under the sea beside sea or atlas lake (rille H), else under a lake
Atlas.cell() floors, so a point on an edge falls in the cell to its south and east
coastal is 8-neighbour adjacency to standing water (the Schlueter pit is now coastal)
the base limitation is stated in the README and the product's assumptions

the sky boat's range with a 6 km climb is the fleet's 150 km less the 83 km of cruise the climb's 2.3 kWh buys, 67 km, keeping the fleet's hover allowance (the reviewer's 80 km left the allowance out)

a region straddles the coast when its candidates lie on both sides of it or its box lies 10-90% under the sea: the Marius Hills and rilles D, E1, H, L and N; rille K's place on the gravity box's edge and what it would remove are stated
the canyon factor is labelled a lower bound, with 55% of each street side open
the heliostat's two-mirror train is stated in its docstring
levels count only where the vault leaves width (9-12 levels); the GRAIL candidates take the lowest ten levels of a vault 0.15-0.22 of their width high
box_shares wraps across 0 E and returns no shares for an empty box
the unused variable is gone; the far-side share stands, since the towns and the districts share one home with the same share (0.857)

round_2.reviewer: the same read-only agent (a2101718f38342246), recomputing without the study's code; its final report is saved as review/round2_report.md on the research drive
round_2.recomputations: all five checks pass: the 2-D water table matches the product within 1.1 m at the five sites asked about (85 m below the ground at the Tranquillitatis pit); the classifications and the coast-straddling totals match exactly; the sky boat's range of 66.7 km with the 6 km climb
findings: rise times run 3-5% long because the implicit steps grow to 25-29 years: 274 years to the Tranquillitatis floor against the product's 289
the high case stands at the ground at all 12 places; rilles G, K and L look 10-197 m dry only because their points sit on rises above their cells' mean ground
the rise keeps within 4.3% of the 1-D comparison at 95% of the rise, where the README said 4%
at the Schlüter pit the water table stands 6-24 m over the floor; with the neighbouring lake treated as land the shallowest floor sits 0.9 m above it
15 psf is 73 kg/m2, where the README said 72
the 0.46 kWh hover allowance includes the fleet's 500 m climb to its flight lane
resolution: the rise-time bias is carried explicitly in the README's method beside the review's figure; it moves no conclusion, since the times span 2.5 times across the specific yields
the five wording points are corrected in the README
the product was regenerated after groundwater.py gained step and horizon controls with its defaults kept: every number is identical, and only that file's hash changed
